summary: Francisco Joaquim Ferreira do Amaral (1844–1923) was a naval officer and politician and President of the Council of Ministers of Portugal in 1908, at the head of the government formed after the regicide of 1 February. He is in the atlas as the holder of that turn at the headship of the government.
